generalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years period 2021-22 to 2025-26

Achieved in at least Two financial years an average financial turnover of Rs.15.00 Lakhs (Usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this contract), should have in the last five years period 2021-22 to 2025-26

Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least one similar work an extent of 50% of the cost of the work Rs.7.50 Lakhs, should have in the last five years period 2021-22 to 2025-26

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
